request.instructions: never rolls/flips, incredibly fast/high braking and acceleration, turns easily at high and low speeds, overpowered handling please

changes.reason: Slightly increased steering to help it turn more easily at speed.
Supporting stability change to help keep the car planted at very high speed.
Supporting anti-roll increase to reduce body roll and flipping.
Supporting stability change to help resist rolling.
Supporting stability change to help resist rolling.
Reduced roll/yaw inertia a bit to make the car more responsive while staying controllable.

vehicleTypeReason: vehicles.meta marks it as VC_EMERGENCY and the pack includes siren settings plus emergency-style light metadata in carvariations/carcols.

security.summary: This looks like a normal data-only vehicle pack: model/texture assets, vehicle metadata, and a simple fxmanifest that only declares files and data_file entries. No executable behavior, downloads, callbacks, or obfuscation were found.

repairs.issue: Stale manifest entries are possible in uploaded manifests, but the importer does not use the uploaded manifest and instead rebuilds from recognized files only.
repairs.action: Ignore the uploaded manifest and generate a fresh manifest from the assets and metadata that actually exist.

repairs.issue: Non-vehicle helper file present in stream directory.
repairs.action: Do not copy this helper file into the rebuilt resource.

repairs.issue: Nonstandard extra image file not required for FiveM vehicle resource loading.
repairs.action: Exclude it from the rebuilt resource unless explicitly needed by the importer policy.
